newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear division sells business for $43 million.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear division sells business for $43 million.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.'s Engineered Products Division said Monday it sold its engineered composite business to Cambridge Industries for $43 million.

The nation's largest tiremaker said the business, located 75 miles southeast of Columbus, Ohio, makes reinforced plastics products such as conveyor and power transmission belts, air springs, hose and moulded rubber products for the automotive industry.
Goodyear's Engineered Products Division said it will continue to restructure its businesses to concentrate on areas where it can excel globally.
Cambridge is based in Madison Heights, Mich.
Goodyear's stock rose 12.5 cents to $62.56 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
